data.name: Kashif
data.gender_notes: Kashif is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root ك-ش-ف (k-sh-f), 'to uncover, reveal'. Kāshif means 'revealer'. Its root is ك-ش-ف (k-sh-f). A common Muslim given name. Kashif is a Arabic name meaning “Revealer; discoverer; uncoverer”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Kashif expresses “Revealer; discoverer; uncoverer”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Arabic root ك-ش-ف (k-sh-f), 'to uncover, reveal'. Kāshif means 'revealer'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kashif total 27, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.
